reader1.note: Tree-sitter tags.scm queries are run per file in a parallel parse pool and produce Symbol records (kind, fileId, line, byte spans) in a dense table.

reader2.note: Tree-sitter tags queries per language feed ingest, which stores one Symbol per definition with kind, file, line, byte extents.

reader1.note: 24 Lang values (cpp, python, ts, go, rust, java, ruby, php, swift, kotlin, ...) each with its own queries/<lang>/tags.scm grammar, dispatched in the one ingest parse pool.

reader2.note: About 22 languages each have their own queries/<lang>/tags.scm, dispatched by Lang in ingest.

reader1.note: Symbol stores sigStartByte/sigEndByte (signature span read for --pack-signatures) and per-symbol docText for doc comments, both filled at ingest.

reader2.note: Symbol stores signature byte spans (sigStartByte/sigEndByte, used by --pack-signatures); no separate stored parameter list, return type or doc-comment text field on the symbol (doc comments only feed the BM25 lexical index).

reader1.note: Only internalLinkage (C/C++ anonymous namespace or static) and JS export import-kind are recorded; no general public/private/async/static field per symbol.

reader2.note: Only C/C++ internal linkage (static/anonymous namespace) and JS export are recorded and used in resolution; no general public/private/async/static field.

reader1.note: Symbol::testScope is set at extraction from in-file test conventions and ORed with path/filename heuristics in isTestSymbol; --ignore-tests and quality verbs filter on it.

reader2.note: isTestPath classifies by directory and filename, Symbol::testScope marks in-file test code; both feed --ignore-tests and the tests-reaching-this map.

reader1.note: Graph holds out-edge CSR (outTargets) and in-edge CSR (inEdges) with provenance; --callers/--callees and MCP find_referencing_symbols query both directions.

reader2.note: Caller-callee edges built from Reference records; --callers, --callees and --around query both directions.

reader1.note: Per-file includeAdj (every language: the files a file imports resolve to) feeds --deps, cycle detection and --mermaid module graph.

reader2.note: Per-language @import.path captures become file-to-file dependency edges, reported by --deps.

reader1.note: Graph::implementors (base to derived) built from RefRole::Extends refs, read by the --lego view and callers/impact.

reader2.note: Reference::isInherit marks derived-to-base edges (extends/implements) kept in the graph and read by implementor/interface views.

reader1.note: buildGraph resolves calls via qualified scope::name, receiver-type narrowing (resolve.h), ES import bindings (prov=import) and an optional SCIP overlay, with name-only edges flagged via=name.

reader2.note: Call resolution in buildGraph uses imports, qualifiers, receiver types, argument counts and scope to pick a definition across files.

reader1.note: --communities runs deterministic Louvain local-moving on the undirected call graph and labels modules; --zoom contracts to multi-level.

reader2.note: Deterministic Louvain local-moving on the call graph yields numbered communities, used by --communities, the HTML overview and --partition.

reader1.note: Refs carry roles Read, Write, Type, Value, Through, Import, Extends beyond Call, queried by --uses and field-affinity.

reader2.note: Reference::role (call/read/write/import/extends/type) and compose edges are stored and queried by --uses, including field reads and writes.

reader1.note: --query ranks symbols by BM25F over subtoken name/doc/body fields with persisted per-def postings in the cache; --grep/--regex scan separately.

reader2.note: BM25F ranking over symbol name, callee, doc-comment and body subtokens with persisted per-definition postings, used by --query.

reader1.searched: grep -rniE embedding|onnx|faiss|word2vec|vector.search|cosine over src/*.h src/*.cpp; only comments (situ.h:236 states no embedding mode is being added) and unrelated words
reader1.note: No embeddings or nearest-neighbour search; the source says explicitly none is added.

reader2.searched: grep -rniE "embedding|onnx|cosine|vector search" over src/*.h src/*.cpp; wrap.h and situ.h state "no embeddings"
reader2.note: The tool is explicitly zero-embedding; no vectors are computed.

reader1.note: didyoumean.h gives bounded edit-distance near-miss suggestions on not-found names and the lexical ranker matches subtokens of partial/differently-cased names.

reader2.note: Bounded edit-distance near-miss suggester and name-token matching resolve misspelt or partial symbol names.

reader1.note: --pattern compiles code-shaped patterns per grammar, --match runs tree-sitter queries, --regex scans text; all return matching locations.

reader2.note: --regex/--grep search text, and --match/--pattern run tree-sitter AST queries, both returning code locations.

reader1.note: --mcp starts a stdio MCP server (kMcpVerbTable) exposing explore, find_symbol, find_referencing_symbols and others.

reader2.note: ripwire --mcp starts a stdio MCP server (or --listen HTTP) exposing the verb catalog as tools.

reader1.note: A flag-driven CLI (ripwire ROOT, --callers, --impact, --query, --cache) prints results, but there are no index and query subcommands; the index is built per run or cached via --cache.

reader2.note: Terminal CLI that indexes and prints results, but driven by flags (--callers, --query, ...) rather than index/query subcommands; only wrap is a subcommand.

reader1.note: --listen=HOST:PORT serves the MCP verbs over a hand-rolled HTTP/1.1 Streamable-HTTP accept loop with optional bearer token; no graph web UI beyond --html file export.

reader2.note: --mcp --listen opens a Streamable-HTTP socket answering graph queries; --html writes an interactive browser view.

reader1.note: Opt-in Claude Code UserPromptSubmit/PreToolUse hook scripts and installable skills call the tool without being asked.

reader2.note: Claude Code and Codex hook scripts plus ripwire wrap installer register the tool with agents.

reader1.note: Multi-root workspaces merge N roots into one graph with label-prefixed files; MCP keeps a registry of warm indexes keyed by root.

reader2.note: Multiple roots merge into one graph with <label>/<rel> paths, and the MCP index keeps a workspace registry of roots.

reader1.note: --cache stores per-file content hash plus raw facts and re-parses only changed files; MCP uses a stat sweep and content-hash stamp.

reader2.note: On-disk cache keyed by content hash with a (size,mtime) warm shortcut re-parses only changed files.

reader1.note: MCP mode keeps a warm index revalidated by mtime/size sweep and a kqueue FS watcher (macOS/BSD only, only elides the sweep); no watcher or git hook on Linux and no push re-indexing.

reader2.note: An MCP-server file-system watcher exists but only on kqueue platforms (macOS/BSD); on Linux it falls back to per-request content-hash staleness checks.

reader1.note: Crawl applies a denylist, git ls-files ignored verdicts (--no-ignore to turn off), --exclude, --max-file-size, a binary NUL sniff and JSON limits.

reader2.note: Crawl honours .gitignore via git, --exclude globs and a --max-file-size ceiling.

reader1.note: --json, --format=columnar|candidates, --sarif (SARIF 2.1.0), --html wiki and markdown --report write documented formats.

reader2.note: Writes SARIF 2.1.0 lint findings, SCIP overlays, columnar/candidates formats and a self-contained HTML wiki.

reader1.note: --mermaid and --zoom --mermaid emit Mermaid module graphs; --html writes a self-contained interactive view.

reader2.note: --html emits a self-contained HTML document with a canvas force-graph of nodes, edges and module views.

reader1.note: --impact=SYM walks reverse call edges transitively (with depth) to list affected symbols.

reader2.note: --impact walks caller edges backwards from a symbol to the affected set with depth.

reader1.note: --pr-context reads the working-tree or BASEREF diff, maps changed lines to symbols and emits callers and blast radius per file.

reader2.note: --pr-context and --situ read git diff, map changed files to indexed symbols and emit callers, tests and owners around them.

reader1.note: --dead-code lists zero-in-edge definitions and --deps/--report list file-level SCC cycles.

reader2.note: --dead-code lists internal functions with zero callers; --deps/--report report file dependency cycles.

reader1.note: Per-symbol cyclomatic (cx), cognitive (ccx), nesting, loc and params are computed at ingest and reported by --metrics and --hotspots.

reader2.note: Cyclomatic (cx) and cognitive (ccx) complexity, loc, params and nesting computed per def at ingest; --metrics and --hotspots report them, git churn feeds hotspots.

reader1.note: --pack-task / MCP explore return ranking, bodies, callers, notes and tests in one output under a deterministic byte/token budget.

reader2.note: --pack-task assembles ranked symbols, bodies, callers and tests into one bundle sized by --token-budget.
